archetypes.name: The Resonant Sage
archetypes.imagePrompt: A calm guardian carved from shadowed stone, soft light glowing inside their chest, standing alone in a field at dusk, realistic, dark muted palette, subtle inner glow, highly detailed.

archetypes.name: The Soft Anchor
archetypes.description: Gentle, steady, and nurturing in relationships.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A figure sitting on a weathered pier over dark water at sunset, soft light around them, posture relaxed and inviting, semi-realistic, moody but warm atmosphere.

archetypes.name: The Stormbound
archetypes.description: Feels intensely inside but stays guarded and overwhelmed.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A person made of swirling storm clouds, faint lightning under the skin, seated in a dim room, shafts of light from a single window, cinematic realism, dramatic shadows.

archetypes.name: The Truth Teller
archetypes.description: Emotionally aware and radically honest, sometimes too sharp.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A figure speaking into the dark, words forming visible glowing lines in the air, sharp edges of light, high contrast, realistic style with a slightly surreal twist.

archetypes.name: The Open Flame
archetypes.description: Expressive and passionate, quick to feel and show emotions.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A person surrounded by small floating sparks in a dark room, eyes bright, mid-motion as if laughing or talking, warm highlights against deep shadow, expressive realism.

archetypes.name: The Magnetic Poet
archetypes.description: Emotionally articulate, romantic, and deeply sensitive.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A lone figure writing at a desk lit by a single lamp, pages drifting into faint glowing symbols, dark room, rich shadows, painterly realistic style.

archetypes.name: The Mirror Mask
archetypes.description: Reads the room fast and adjusts their emotional display.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A person holding a half-mirror mask, one eye visible and observant, reflections of other faces in the mask surface, cool tones, realistic with subtle surreal reflections.

archetypes.name: The Boundary Breaker
archetypes.description: Open, intense, and quick to share deeply and directly.
archetypes.imagePrompt: Two figures facing each other in a dark space, one pouring glowing light from their chest toward the other, bold and intimate, realistic style, strong contrast.

archetypes.name: The Iron Mask
archetypes.description: Emotionally shut down, highly self-protective, hard to read.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A figure in a smooth dark metal mask, eyes hidden, standing against a black background, faint cracks with tiny light leaking through, hyperreal texture.

archetypes.name: The Strategist
archetypes.description: Thinks before feeling, manages emotions through logic.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A person at a table covered in maps and diagrams lit from above, expression calm and focused, everything else fading into darkness, realistic, clean lines.

archetypes.name: The Gentle Ghost
archetypes.description: Pulls back softly when overwhelmed, avoids conflict.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A faint, semi-transparent figure walking down a dim hallway, edges blurred into the shadows, soft cool tones, melancholic but peaceful realism.

archetypes.name: The Fortress-Keeper
archetypes.description: Slow to trust but fiercely loyal once you are inside.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A tall stone gate in the night with a single warm light deep inside, heavy doors slightly open, realistic stone texture, moody sky above.

archetypes.name: The Quiet Depth
archetypes.description: Private but deeply loyal and emotionally present with a few.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A person sitting by a dark lake at night, stars reflected in the water, posture relaxed and turned slightly away, subtle glow on the shoreline, serene realism.

archetypes.name: The Open Seeker
archetypes.description: Actively looks for meaningful connection and new emotional experiences.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A traveler standing at a crossroads under a twilight sky, paths lit with soft lanterns, figure looking ahead with curiosity, detailed and atmospheric.

archetypes.name: The Tethered Caretaker
archetypes.description: Takes care of others first and often forgets their own needs.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A person helping another person, one figure glowing brightly while tending to the other, their own form slightly faded, warm and compassionate atmosphere, realistic style.

archetypes.name: The Inner Compass
archetypes.description: Balanced between independence and closeness, steady and clear.
archetypes.imagePrompt: A figure standing in a dark space with a softly glowing compass in their hands, light illuminating their face, calm expression, grounded, hyperreal detail.
